q.en: How do I request an appointment?

a.id: Kirim pertanyaan melalui WhatsApp dan tunggu konfirmasi klinik.
a.en: Send your request via WhatsApp and wait for clinic confirmation.
Ask for current hours before visiting.

a.id: Harga belum tersedia. Tanyakan perkiraan biaya dan pemeriksaan yang diperlukan kepada klinik.
a.en: Prices are not available. Ask the clinic about estimated fees and assessment requirements.

a.en: Coverage arrangements have not been verified. Please ask the clinic.

q.id: Apa yang perlu disiapkan sebelum datang?
q.en: What should I prepare before visiting?

a.id: Siapkan keluhan, riwayat perawatan, dan daftar obat untuk disampaikan saat pemeriksaan. Konfirmasikan lokasi terlebih dahulu.
a.en: Prepare your concerns, care history, and medication list for your assessment. Confirm the location first.
